segments.title: Count to 5 in Spanish!
segments.say: {es:¡Hola!} Hi friends! Let's count to five in Spanish, with Lucía from Seville.

segments.title: ¡Muy bien!
segments.say: {es:¡Muy bien!} That means, very good! You did it!

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.sub: to a little one who loves counting
segments.say: Send this to a little one who loves counting, and follow for a new word every day!
